en.headline: FEHD reports progress in Operation Thunderbolt targeting rodent hotspots
en.dek: The department has inspected 1,373 locations since 4 November, capturing 103 live rats and sealing 199 hiding spots, with a night team catching over 50 rats in Kwun Tong.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Thursday that Operation Thunderbolt, launched on 4 November to target severe rodent infestations, had inspected 1,373 locations across Hong Kong.

Of these, 1,171 were government-managed sites such as parks. Officers found 199 rat holes or hiding spots, captured 103 live rats, collected 51 dead rats, and completed poisoning and sealing at 92 locations.

In Kwun Tong’s Shing Yip Street, the department had earlier issued 15 abatement notices to an industrial building. After follow-up showed the problem continued, a night team intervened and caught more than 50 rats on the first night, with further work ongoing.

A spokesman said the operation focuses on nesting sites rather than only trapping where rats appear, and that managers of premises must still fulfil their daily cleaning and prevention duties. The department may prosecute under the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance if needed.

zh.headline: 食環署「雷霆行動」核查逾千位置 觀塘夜間捕鼠逾50隻
zh.dek: 行動自11月4日起核查1,373個地點，發現199個藏匿點，捕獲103隻活鼠，並在92個位置完成毒殺及封堵。
body: 食物環境衞生署周四表示，針對嚴重鼠患的「雷霆行動」自11月4日展開以來，已在全港核查1,373個位置。
當中包括1,171個政府管理場地如公園。署方發現199個鼠洞或藏匿點，捕獲103隻活鼠、收集51隻死鼠，並已在92個位置完成毒殺及封堵。
觀塘成業街一幢工業大廈早前獲發15張消除蟲鼠通知，跟進後問題持續，署方派出夜間滅鼠隊，首晚已捕獲超過50隻老鼠，相關工作仍在進行。
發言人指行動重點追查巢穴而非只在出沒位置捕鼠，場地管理者仍須履行日常清潔及防鼠責任。如有需要，可根據《公眾衞生及市政條例》提出檢控。
